description: All RNGs for PopulationStudy Experiment 2. Fixed leave-patient-out split (user-specified). Val pair split and torch/numpy seeds reuse the same integer.
val_split_method: per train patient: Random(val_split_seed + patient_index).shuffle(100 pairs); take first 10% as val. Val is train-patients only; P7/P9 never enter train or val.
